original.target_description: Overall baseline Impact of Event Scale score for the two most prominent intrusive memories predicting six-month BDI, controlling baseline BDI, in initially clinically depressed patients; participants without memories scored zero.

n.sample_role: Patients with baseline major depressive episode and returned six-month BDI, used in follow-up prediction regressions.
n.exclusions: 62 baseline patients; 52 recontacted; 44 returned completed follow-up BDIs. Baseline exclusions: recent psychotic episode, history suggesting manic depressive psychosis/organic brain disease/substance abuse, comorbid PTSD; two patients with OCD excluded. No additional exclusions reported for the target regression.

Full-text acquisition failed independently for original and replication. No statistics or narrative verdict extracted from abstracts, metadata, secondary citations, or significance. Acquisition routes recorded in the DOI-keyed text-cache miss records.
Source follow-up: Published article supplied by licensed EBSCO PsycInfo service; title and authors verified in named primary text. Overall IES score combines intrusion and avoidance; this is not the separate Intrusion-subscale coefficient .35 with t=2.60 and p<.02. Participants without intrusive memories remained in this analysis with score zero. Source text OCR renders IES as IBS and beta as /3; numeric values retained as printed. No replication extraction or success verdict requested.
Source follow-up: PDF target pages rendered and checked: canonical TXT control glyphs misencode equals, minus and greater-than signs and beta as b. Quotes preserve canonical TXT; numeric values and p bounds follow the rendered primary PDF. Known sample mismatch: the supplied locator describes participants with current depression; this primary article reports mixed-community/untreated samples, with no current-depression-only target test located. The extracted statistics describe the explicitly named closest analysis; they do not verify the requested depressed subgroup. Reported success for that target remains unestablished.
